name: Fan Fan Long
source:
Fan Fan's impact as the leader of the Foundation for Altruism and Nurturing Project has been nothing short of monumental, touching the lives of countless children battling illnesses. Her ability to evoke empathy from an audience of potential donors stems not only from her surprising appearance, but from her selfless participation in human drug trials.

Despite the staggering success of her charity, Fan Fan leads a life of extreme frugality, even refusing a stipend to cover her living expenses. In her eyes, every cent must be dedicated to the cause she champions, and a diet of ramen and macaroni is well-worth the joy reflected in the smiles of the children that she works with.

Fan Fan rarely speaks about her own conditions, preferring to redirect attention towards more common diseases and those in greater need. Her admirers are overwhelmingly touched by this act of supreme selflessness-though more unsavory types still engage in unwanted speculation about both her motivations and her private life...

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/Fanganronpa/comments/1eo2l2z/meet_fan_fan_long_the_former_ultimate_human/]bio[/url]]
